standard.summary: 将大的激活张量从 GPU 迁移到 CPU pinned memory，减少 GPU 激活内存占用。backward 时自动搬回 GPU 计算梯度。
standard.effect: activation_cpu_offload_min_tensor_mb 控制最小迁移阈值（只迁移大张量）。activation_cpu_offload_pool_gb 控制预分配的 pinned memory 池大小。
standard.whenToUse: 激活内存成为主要瓶颈时（尤其是 DiT 模型的大序列长度场景）。
standard.avoidWhen: PCIe 带宽不足时迁移开销太大。已经用 gradient_checkpointing 时可能不需要。

standard_en.summary: Moves large activation tensors off the GPU into CPU pinned memory to cut GPU activation memory; they are brought back automatically for the backward pass.
standard_en.effect: activation_cpu_offload_min_tensor_mb controls the minimum size that gets moved (only large tensors do). activation_cpu_offload_pool_gb controls the size of the pre-allocated pinned-memory pool.
standard_en.whenToUse: When activation memory is the main bottleneck, especially for DiT models at long sequence lengths.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When PCIe bandwidth is short the transfer cost is too high. Probably unnecessary if you already use gradient_checkpointing.

advanced.principle: 在 forward 时 hook autograd save_for_backward，将大于阈值的激活张量异步复制到预分配的 CPU pinned memory pool，GPU 端释放。backward 时自动触发 CUDA→CPU→GPU 的来回搬运。pool_gb 控制 pinned memory 预分配量。min_tensor_mb 避免迁移太小的张量（开销不划算）。
advanced.intervention: save_for_backward hook → async CPU copy → GPU free → backward 时 copy back。
advanced.expectedImpact: 显存和速度取决于张量规模、PCIe、重算策略及主机内存。Boogu Base/FLUX.2 Klein 的 BF16、1024/BS1、LoRA 短程对照已验证三种传输策略；shared 配合冻结权重按需读取与完整块重算，相比无激活搬运约降低 11.5%/32% 活跃显存。该数字不是整卡占用，也不代表其它 adapter、Edit、量化或编译组合。
advanced.tradeoffs: 同时启用 activation_compression_enabled 时，现有 saved-tensor hooks 路径以卸载优先，不叠加压缩。

advanced_en.principle: During forward, hooks autograd save_for_backward, asynchronously copying activation tensors larger than the threshold into a preallocated CPU pinned memory pool and freeing them on the GPU side. Backward automatically triggers the CUDA→CPU→GPU round trip. pool_gb controls the pinned-memory preallocation. min_tensor_mb avoids migrating tensors too small to be worth it.
advanced_en.intervention: save_for_backward hook → async CPU copy → GPU free → copy back on backward.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Memory and speed depend on tensor sizes, PCIe, checkpointing and host memory. Short BF16, 1024/BS1 LoRA runs validated all three transfer policies on Boogu Base and FLUX.2 Klein. With frozen-weight backward reads and full-block checkpointing, shared reduced active allocations by about 11.5%/32% versus no activation transfers. These are not whole-device memory figures and do not validate other adapters, Edit, quantization or compilation combinations.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: When activation_compression_enabled is also enabled, offload takes precedence in the existing saved-tensor hook path; compression is not combined with it.
